trust_decision.summary: Whether a stored ApiToken row may hold the bearer secret itself: at the pinned commit the token is generated and persisted in plaintext at creation, and bearer auth compares the raw header value against the stored column, so a DB/backup reader gains full account access.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'API tokens stored in plaintext'; the only write of ApiToken.token is in the create handler behind POST /v1/users/me/api-tokens.

fix_sites.entry_point: Bearer auth for every /api/* route in builder (apps/builder/src/app/api/[[...rest]]/route.ts:118-121) and viewer (apps/viewer/src/app/api/[[...rest]]/route.ts:97-98)
none found at pinned commit: exported but no importer in the tree (second implementation of bearer lookup, Next pages-API style)
new helper packages/lib/src/apiToken.ts (hashApiToken/generateApiToken/isHashedApiToken) used by the three sites above

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: apps/viewer/src/helpers/authenticateUser.ts:10-20 (separate bearer lookup in the viewer app, same plaintext comparison, unreferenced at the pinned commit); also packages/auth/src/helpers/authenticateWithBearerToken.ts:9-11 sits in a different package from the landing point

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The viewer authenticateUser helper has no callers at the pinned commit (dead/legacy code), and the auth package 'only reads' tokens, so a solver fixing 'storage' can argue only the create handler writes the secret.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Existing plaintext tokens already in the DB (and seeded test tokens) must keep authenticating after the change (the fix falls back to a raw lookup and rehashes on use), and the create response must still return the plaintext once for the UI copy dialog; hashing-only lookups or dropping the token from the create response break both.

O6_input_shapes: newly created tokens (hashed at write, plaintext returned once)
legacy plaintext rows already stored (raw-match fallback, then rehash in place)
presented value that equals a stored hash (rejected via isHashedApiToken so the hash itself is not a credential)
Authorization header scheme variants: case-insensitive 'Bearer' and extra whitespace (regex replaces slice(7))

O7_producer.where: apps/builder/src/features/user/server/handleCreateApiToken.ts:24-26 produces the stored value; packages/auth/src/helpers/authenticateWithBearerToken.ts:9-11 consumes it

O8_uncovered_routes.route: DELETE /v1/users/me/api-tokens/{tokenId} returns the full deleted row including the stored token column via an output schema that declares `token`; untouched by the fix (after the fix it echoes the hash).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The token is being revoked in the same call, so echoing it is harmless; and after hashing it is 'only a hash'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same directory as the landing point (apps/builder/src/features/user/server), separate handler and schema

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a list/export path that selects the token column (e.g. for a 'last 4 chars' hint) and so keeps depending on plaintext storage
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: UIs commonly show a masked token suffix; a maintainer could add `token: true` to the select to build it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second token source (query param ?token= or x-api-key header) in a separate helper that compares the raw value to the column
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Webhook/embed integrations often cannot set headers; a fallback lookup in another package would be written independently of the hashed path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a seed/admin script or CLI in packages/scripts that inserts tokens directly with prisma.apiToken.create
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Ops scripts that provision service users write rows directly and would skip the create handler's hashing (a producer the check never calls).

O9_family: cleartext storage of credentials (CWE-312) / API-token at-rest protection

O10_build.project_tests: No unit tests for apiToken/auth at pinned commit; only Playwright e2e that use the seeded token (apps/viewer/src/test/chat.spec.ts:54, apps/viewer/src/test/webhookListener.spec.ts:30). Vitest exists for packages/lib (packages/lib/src/safeKy.test.ts).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Hash in handleCreateApiToken and in authenticateWithBearerToken only, comparing hash(header) to the column, which locks out every existing plaintext token and leaves the viewer helper and the delete response unchanged.

out_of_scope_notes: Account model stores OAuth refresh/access/id tokens as plain String columns (packages/prisma/postgresql/schema.prisma:21-29); separate NextAuth concern, not pursued.
Migration packages/prisma/postgresql/migrations/20220603074700_add_tokens/migration.sql:21 copied legacy User.apiToken values into ApiToken in plaintext; historical, not a runtime route.
